scope: Fresh official-schema database per case; fixture target configuration and one queued job are seeded before the actual worker starts. In the two reference-removal races, observe its real validation query blocked on the referenced table, detach only the synthetic reference and remove that exact synthetic row in the barrier-owning transaction, then release. No application clock, running job, lease or outcome is edited and no constraint is disabled. Observe terminal validation without Canvas reads or changes to issued rows.

cases.name: binding_platform_mismatch
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_program_bindings SET platform_id='platform-secondary' WHERE id='binding-review'

cases.name: platform_disabled
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_platforms SET enabled=false WHERE id='platform-review'

cases.name: binding_disabled
seed: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_program_bindings SET enabled=false WHERE id='binding-review'

reference_race.barrier_sql: LOCK TABLE issuance_service.applications IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE
reference_race.blocked_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query ILIKE '%SELECT%FROM issuance_service.applications%'
release_sql: DELETE FROM issuance_service.applications WHERE id='application-race' AND organization_id='org-review'
reference_race.absent_sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issuance_service.applications WHERE id='application-race')

reference_race.barrier_sql: LOCK TABLE issuance_service.canvas_award_candidates IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE
reference_race.blocked_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query ILIKE '%SELECT%FROM issuance_service.canvas_award_candidates%'
release_sql: DELETE FROM issuance_service.canvas_award_candidates WHERE id='candidate-race' AND organization_id='org-review'
reference_race.absent_sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issuance_service.canvas_award_candidates WHERE id='candidate-race')
